name: extension-rpc
description: Custom Personal Discord Rich Presence for Visual Studio Code

extensionRpc.enabled.description: Enable or disable Discord Rich Presence.

extensionRpc.detailsFormat.description: Primary Rich Presence text. Variables: {project}, {file}, {language}, and {icon}.

extensionRpc.stateFormat.description: Secondary Rich Presence text. Variables: {project}, {file}, {language}, and {icon}.

extensionRpc.largeImageTextFormat.description: Text displayed when hovering over the large image.

extensionRpc.showElapsedTime.description: Show how long the current VS Code session has been running.

extensionRpc.iconOverride.description: Force an icon from 1 to 8. Use 0 for automatic project-based selection.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
